summary: Lower a direct static field to C# storage only when access is through the defining class, subclass shadowing is impossible, reflection is absent, and initialization timing is explicitly preserved.

target.notes: Emit static C# storage but assign it from the generated eager class-initialization sequence rather than relying on CLR lazy field initialization.

caveats: Initialization timing is still governed by `classes.static.initialization_order`.

tests.name: direct static read
tests.expected_csharp: public static double x; /* class eval */ C.x = 3d;

tests.name: edge: subclass access excludes native storage
tests.input: class C { static x=3; } class D extends C {} D.x=4; console.log(C.x,D.x);
tests.expected_behavior: prints 3 4; this rule must not match
